name: condition-builder
tagline: Condition builder — numbered rows of field / operator / value, 「すべての条件を満たす」 / 「いずれかの条件を満たす」 / custom logic `1 AND (2 OR 3)`, add/remove rows, 「並び順」, save as a named view; applied on SUBMIT inside a role="search" Form. Composition, not a component. Docked beside the list it is the Salesforce list-view filter panel.
